NFL DFS Quarterback Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 10, 10:42 AM ET

Brock Purdy is the top-projected quarterback on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 21.5 DraftKings points for $7,000, at Dallas. Josh Allen (21.4, $7,500) and Dak Prescott (19.3, $6,400) are next.

Carson Beck returns the most per dollar among quarterbacks projected for at least 15 points: 3.97 projected points per $1,000 at $4,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 10, 10:42 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Quarterbacks to know in Week 10

Brock Purdy, SF at DAL ($7,000)

Brock Purdy carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.5 DraftKings points at $7,000, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.1 points clear of Josh Allen. The model includes 4.7 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.07 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 21.4 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 38.8, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 30 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Josh Allen, BUF at NYJ ($7,500)

Josh Allen projects 2nd at the position with 21.4 DraftKings points at $7,500, 5th on the main slate overall. The model includes 7.8 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.85 projected points per $1,000, 14th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 21.5 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 39.4, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is an 8.5-point favorite on the road against the Jets, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Value: Carson Beck, ARI vs LAR ($4,200)

Carson Beck projects for 16.7 DraftKings points at $4,200, which works out to 3.97 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 17 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Beck averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 29.9, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Arizona is a 9.5-point underdog at home against the Rams, with an implied team total of 15.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
